items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: He went, he went, he went, uh, he went away the same time Bunk went away. Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: I don't know what happened to him.

He went away from here. Long time ago. I think he died. He went, he went, he went, uh, he went away the same time Bunk went away. Bunk Johnson. When Bunk left here, Prevost left. And they went up the line somewhere in different places and stayed away a long time, you see.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I think Bunk Johnson was playing in one of the bands at that time. Remember Bunk Johnson? Bunk Johnson was playing with the Silver Leaf, I think. Well, I played with the Silver Leaf for a good while.

ctx.x: Did they have some of the blowing instruments too or mostly strings?

They had blowing instruments too, yeah. Oh, the dance band? Yeah, they had, I think Bunk Johnson was playing in one of the bands at that time. Remember Bunk Johnson? Bunk Johnson was playing with the Silver Leaf, I think. Well, I played with the Silver Leaf for a good while. There's spot jobs, you know, up on the Pelican. Who was the leader of that? Uh, uh, Poisey Umphrey. Oh, Percy or was it his father? No, Poisey. Poisey, yeah. Poisey Umphrey. Willie Umphrey. Willie Umphrey. Willie Umphrey, yeah. The clarinet…
Was that the place called, um, later the Entertainers or 101 Ranch? Yeah.
